FSSAI Issues Notices to Nestlé India and Zydus Wellness Over Product Claims

The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has issued notices to Nestlé India and Zydus Wellness concerning claims made on their products. Nestlé India received notices regarding Lactogen Pro 1 and Nan Excella Pro Stage 1, with FSSAI seeking scientific evidence to support the product claims. Zydus Wellness was also issued a notice for its product Complan, to which the company responded that its claims are factual and scientifically supported.
